test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) his advice

(B) the students

(C) accepted

(D) happily
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **BCAD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence should start with the subject **"the students"** (B).
 
• Next, the verb **"accepted"** (C) logically follows the subject.
 
• Then comes the object **"his advice"** (A), which is what was accepted.
 
• Finally, the adverb **"happily"** (D) completes the sentence, showing the manner of acceptance.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BCAD**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BACD):** Incorrect because "the students his advice accepted happily" is not a grammatically valid order.
 
• **Option 2 (BADC):** Incorrect as "the students advice happily accepted" misplaces the object and adverb.
 
• **Option 4 (ABCD):** Incorrect because "his advice the students accepted happily" is awkward and not the most natural structure.
